caption_headline: How the work was done, and where the list was fixed
caption_explanation: Everything here is a computational reanalysis of public data. No laboratory experiment was performed at any stage, and nothing on the right-hand side was allowed to change the candidate list on the left. The dashed box records what was added after the freeze, so the diagram does not imply that the whole study was specified in advance — it was not.

caption_headline: Effect size and certainty are different things, and the four candidates were not chosen on effect size alone
caption_explanation: 13 of 19,103 genes met the pre-registered gate. KDM1A and TLK2 are the most certain hits; USP34 sits 12th of 13 by effect size. Marker shape shows how each candidate entered the set — the four did not come from one selection rule. EML5 and CITED2 were displaced from the original frozen shortlist by the same reinterpretation. Colour identifies the gene, never its rank.

caption_headline: Two of sixteen candidate gene-and-dataset combinations reach false discovery rate 0.05
caption_explanation: Filled = reaches FDR 0.05; hollow ring = does not. Each candidate is corroborated in at most one dataset. Grey = all other genes in that dataset (Benjamini–Hochberg across the transcriptome, within each dataset). These are not four equivalent replications: panel 4 is an acute 12-hour response, not resistance; panel 3 compares different, unpaired patients from two tissue banks. Coincident candidates are concentric rings at their true position — nothing is displaced.

caption_headline: Programme-level signal is present in all four datasets, and the adhesion/motility programme points the other way after 12 hours
caption_explanation: Oestrogen response is suppressed in all four datasets and cell-cycle entry in all four — the expected pharmacology, and an internal check that the datasets behave sensibly. The boxed row is the observation this project adds: Hallmark epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition enrichment is positive in the three long-term settings and negative after 12 hours of tamoxifen. This is a gene-set score, not a measured migration phenotype, and the acute dataset differs from the other three in more than duration.

caption_headline: The two connected candidates are joined by one route, not four
caption_explanation: Associations are undirected: they are not activation, not inhibition, not necessarily physical binding, and no arrows are drawn. A short path between two proteins is not a mechanism. Panel B is the reason this connection is weak evidence rather than strong: the four equally short routes differ only in which member of one small gene family occupies the middle position.

caption_headline: Needing a gene at baseline and being sensitised by losing it are two different measurements, and they need not coincide
caption_explanation: TLK2 is required for survival by 9 of 11 oestrogen-receptor-positive cell lines whether or not tamoxifen is present. That is a limitation, not a strength: a gene most cells already need offers a narrower, less tamoxifen-specific therapeutic window. KDM1A is the opposite — the strongest sensitiser in the screen, required by none of the 11. Counts, not percentages, out of the 11 lines with a dependency value. Baseline dependency in cancer cell lines is not normal-tissue safety and says nothing about toxicity.

caption_headline: The four differ in the kind of chemical evidence they have, not in how much of one thing
caption_explanation: Reachability only. Nothing here is efficacy, selectivity or safety, and no docking, binding prediction or molecular modelling was performed anywhere in this project. KDM1A is the mature target: an inhibitor-bound structure and clinical-stage compounds already exist. USP34's structure holds a covalent ubiquitin activity probe, not a drug, over about 12% of the protein — an unexplored opportunity, not a validated one. Counter-evidence for USP34: losing it has been reported to push breast cells toward a more mobile state (PMID 28499884).
